'''Ducianne ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Kalimahr militia]] member, who answered to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorus]]. In [[25,793 BBY]] she was present when a [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] tried to kill the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]]. She was responsible for locating one of the terrorist's toe-claws, which was snagged in her uniform.<ref name="Into the Void" />
